title: PickMoment: Continuous-Time Single-Image-to-Video via Learning Deblurring and Blur-to-Video
title_zh: PickMoment：通过学习去模糊与模糊转视频实现连续时间单图转视频

paragraphs.en: Motion blur arises from the temporal integration of a continuous sharp signal over a finite exposure window, yet existing learning-based methods sidestep this physical model and predict only the sharp signal itself: most single-image deblurring methods recover a single frame at the exposure center, while blur-to-video methods predict a fixed set of frames. We introduce PickMoment, a continuous-time reformulation that directly learns the interval-mean blur over arbitrary sub-intervals of the exposure with a single deterministic model. Drawing an analogy to MeanFlow’s average-velocity formulation, we train the model with three supervisions derived from the blur integral: an empirical reconstruction loss from available subframes, an additivity loss that enforces self-consistency across overlapping sub-intervals, and a sharp-frame loss anchored at the zero-interval limit. A single trained model unifies single-image deblurring, blur-to-video generation, and continuous-time pick-a-moment recovery as different queries to the same network, with no separate training for each task. Our PickMoment achieves state-of-the-art performance among generative-based deblurring methods on GoPro and HIDE while competitive against restoration-based methods on RealBlur, and the highest per-frame fidelity on GoPro-7 blur-to-video, all in a single forward pass without iterative sampling. Our project page is available here .

paragraphs.en: To exploit this structure, blur-to-video methods aim to recover the entire sharp sequence from a single blurry image. Early work [ 15 ] trains with order-invariant losses that accept both forward and reversed sequences as valid targets. Subsequent methods introduce learned motion latents [ 31 ] , differentiable warping with auxiliary regularizers [ 2 ] , latent-space ordering classifiers [ 30 ] , or, most recently, sampling from a pretrained video diffusion prior [ 37 ] . Across both single-image deblurring and blur-to-video tasks, however, the dominant learning target has remained the sharp signal itself, either at one timestep or at a fixed set of discrete timesteps. This fails to fully exploit the temporal ordering encoded in the physical formulation of Eq. 1 , where the model is used only for synthesizing training data rather than shaping the network predictions themselves. In contrast, rather than learning a direct mapping from blur to a sharp frame or a sequence of video frames, our goal is to directly predict the blur formation integral itself from a single blurred image, allowing the physical model to serve as a core component of the learning objective.
paragraphs.zh: 为了利用这一结构，模糊到视频方法旨在从单张模糊图像中恢复整个清晰序列。 早期工作 [ 15 ] 使用顺序不变的损失进行训练，该损失将正向和反向序列都视为有效目标。 后续方法引入了可学习的运动潜在表示 [ 31 ]、带辅助正则化项的可微分扭曲 [ 2 ]、潜在空间排序分类器 [ 30 ]，以及最近的从预训练视频扩散先验中采样的方法 [ 37 ]。 然而，在单图像去模糊和模糊到视频这两个任务中，主流的学习目标仍然是清晰信号本身，即单个时间步或一组固定的离散时间步上的清晰信号。 这未能充分利用式 1 的物理建模中所编码的时间顺序，其中该模型仅用于合成训练数据，而不是塑造网络预测本身。 与此相反，我们的目标不是学习从模糊到清晰帧或视频帧序列的直接映射，而是直接从单张模糊图像预测模糊形成积分本身，使物理模型成为学习目标的核心组成部分。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we propose PickMoment , which trains a network to predict blur observations over arbitrary sub-intervals of the exposure duration, enabling the learning of continuous temporal representations that generalize to any temporal range from a single blurry input. Specifically, we leverage two structural properties of motion blur: the blurry input itself corresponds to the blur integrated over the full exposure interval, and standard datasets [ 28 , 35 ] provide subframes with known temporal ordering. Together, these properties, combined with our MeanFlow-inspired training strategy, enable the network to produce deterministic and direction-consistent reconstructions in a single forward pass. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , single-image deblurring, blur-to-video generation, and arbitrary-moment recovery naturally emerge as different queries to the same model. Furthermore, sharp frames at arbitrary continuous timesteps arise as the zero-interval limit, enabling continuous-time “pick-a-moment” recovery from a single blurred image.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出 PickMoment，它训练一个网络来预测曝光时长任意子区间上的模糊观测，从而能够从单个模糊输入学习可泛化到任意时间范围的连续时间表示。 具体而言，我们利用运动模糊的两个结构特性：模糊输入本身对应于整个曝光区间上积分得到的模糊，而标准数据集 [28, 35] 提供了具有已知时间顺序的子帧。 二者结合起来，再配合我们受 MeanFlow 启发的训练策略，使网络能够在单次前向传播中产生确定且方向一致的重建结果。 如图 1 所示，单图像去模糊、模糊到视频的生成以及任意时刻恢复自然地表现为对同一模型的不同查询。 此外，任意连续时间步上的清晰帧作为零区间极限而出现，从而能够从单幅模糊图像实现连续时间的“选取时刻”恢复。

paragraphs.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows: We introduce PickMoment , a physically grounded reformulation of motion deblurring that models a blurry image as a continuous-time integral over the exposure interval and casts deblurring as the prediction of interval-mean sharp content over arbitrary sub-intervals. By learning a continuous temporal representation, PickMoment unifies single-image deblurring, blur-to-video generation, and continuous-time “pick-a-moment” recovery within a single formulation, without requiring separate models or objectives for different tasks. To effectively learn this formulation, we draw a structural analogy between sub-interval blur prediction and the average velocity formulation of MeanFlow. Specifically, we exploit two integral-derived identities — additivity across sub-intervals and the zero-interval limit — as supervision signals for temporally coherent learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PickMoment achieves state-of-the-art performance among generative-based deblurring methods on GoPro and HIDE while remaining competitive with restoration-based baselines, and enables 1-step continuous-time blur-to-video generation with significantly reduced computational cost compared to video diffusion approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 综上所述，我们的贡献如下：我们提出了 PickMoment，这是一种具有物理依据的运动去模糊重构方法，它将模糊图像建模为曝光区间上的连续时间积分，并将去模糊转化为对任意子区间上的区间均值清晰内容的预测。 通过学习连续的时间表示，PickMoment 在单一公式框架下统一了单图像去模糊、模糊到视频生成以及连续时间的「选取时刻」恢复，无需为不同任务使用单独的模型或目标函数。 为了有效学习这一公式，我们在子区间模糊预测与 MeanFlow 的平均速度公式之间建立了结构类比。 具体而言，我们利用两个由积分导出的恒等式——跨子区间的可加性和零区间极限——作为时间一致性学习的监督信号。 大量实验表明，PickMoment 在 GoPro 和 HIDE 数据集上于基于生成式方法的去模糊方法中取得了最先进的性能，同时与基于复原的基线方法相比仍具竞争力，并能够以一步实现连续时间的模糊到视频生成，与视频扩散方法相比显著降低了计算成本。

sents.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows: We introduce PickMoment , a physically grounded reformulation of motion deblurring that models a blurry image as a continuous-time integral over the exposure interval and casts deblurring as the prediction of interval-mean sharp content over arbitrary sub-intervals.
sents.zh: 综上所述，我们的贡献如下：我们提出了 PickMoment，这是一种具有物理依据的运动去模糊重构方法，它将模糊图像建模为曝光区间上的连续时间积分，并将去模糊转化为对任意子区间上的区间均值清晰内容的预测。

sents.en: By learning a continuous temporal representation, PickMoment unifies single-image deblurring, blur-to-video generation, and continuous-time “pick-a-moment” recovery within a single formulation, without requiring separate models or objectives for different tasks.
sents.zh: 通过学习连续的时间表示，PickMoment 在单一公式框架下统一了单图像去模糊、模糊到视频生成以及连续时间的「选取时刻」恢复，无需为不同任务使用单独的模型或目标函数。

sents.en: To effectively learn this formulation, we draw a structural analogy between sub-interval blur prediction and the average velocity formulation of MeanFlow.
sents.zh: 为了有效学习这一公式，我们在子区间模糊预测与 MeanFlow 的平均速度公式之间建立了结构类比。

sents.en: Specifically, we exploit two integral-derived identities — additivity across sub-intervals and the zero-interval limit — as supervision signals for temporally coherent learning.
sents.zh: 具体而言，我们利用两个由积分导出的恒等式——跨子区间的可加性和零区间极限——作为时间一致性学习的监督信号。

sents.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that PickMoment achieves state-of-the-art performance among generative-based deblurring methods on GoPro and HIDE while remaining competitive with restoration-based baselines, and enables 1-step continuous-time blur-to-video generation with significantly reduced computational cost compared to video diffusion approaches.
sents.zh: 大量实验表明，PickMoment 在 GoPro 和 HIDE 数据集上于基于生成式方法的去模糊方法中取得了最先进的性能，同时与基于复原的基线方法相比仍具竞争力，并能够以一步实现连续时间的模糊到视频生成，与视频扩散方法相比显著降低了计算成本。

paragraphs.en: Single-image motion deblurring aims to recover a sharp image from a single blurry observation, evolving from traditional handcrafted priors [ 9 , 29 ] to deep learning. End-to-end CNN architectures [ 28 , 36 , 46 , 19 , 44 , 4 , 8 , 27 ] pioneered direct blur-to-sharp mapping, followed by transformer-based models [ 45 , 39 , 18 ] that achieve state-of-the-art per-pixel fidelity through global self-attention. More recently, diffusion-based approaches have emerged to push perceptual quality. HI-Diff [ 5 ] integrates hierarchical latent priors into a diffusion framework for deblurring, and BlurDM [ 12 ] embeds the blur formation process into a dual-diffusion scheme (jointly diffusing noise and blur) and serves as a prior for downstream deblurring networks. A parallel line adapts large pretrained generative models for image restoration. DiffBIR [ 20 ] restores blind degradations using the Stable Diffusion [ 33 ] prior, and Diff-Plugin [ 24 ] provides plug-ins for diffusion-based low-level tasks. Most recently, several methods adapt the same prior specifically for deblurring. UID-Diff [ 6 ] addresses unpaired deblurring with a decoupled diffusion model on top of a refined VAE [ 17 ] , and the concurrent FideDiff [ 22 ] adapts Stable Diffusion through consistency training for one-step inference. However, all these methods predict only a single sharp frame at the temporal center of the exposure, leaving users unable to pick any other moment encoded in the blur.
paragraphs.zh: 单图像运动去模糊旨在从单张模糊观测中恢复清晰图像，其发展从传统的手工先验 [ 9 , 29 ] 演进到深度学习。 端到端 CNN 架构 [ 28 , 36 , 46 , 19 , 44 , 4 , 8 , 27 ] 率先实现了从模糊到清晰的直接映射，随后是基于 Transformer 的模型 [ 45 , 39 , 18 ] ，它们通过全局自注意力达到了逐像素保真度的最先进水平。 最近，基于扩散的方法开始涌现，以进一步提升感知质量。 HI-Diff [ 5 ] 将分层隐空间先验融入扩散框架用于去模糊，BlurDM [ 12 ] 则将模糊成像过程嵌入双扩散方案（同时扩散噪声与模糊），并作为下游去模糊网络的先验。 另一条并行的研究路线是将大型预训练生成模型适配于图像复原。 DiffBIR [ 20 ] 利用 Stable Diffusion [ 33 ] 先验复原盲退化，Diff-Plugin [ 24 ] 为基于扩散的底层任务提供了插件。 就在最近，有若干方法专门将同一先验适配于去模糊任务。 UID-Diff [ 6 ] 在改进的 VAE [ 17 ] 之上，使用解耦的扩散模型处理非成对去模糊；同期工作 FideDiff [ 22 ] 则通过一致性训练将 Stable Diffusion 适配为单步推理。 然而，上述所有方法都只能预测曝光时间中心处的一帧清晰图像，用户无法选取模糊中所编码的其他任意时刻。

paragraphs.en: Beyond single-frame deblurring, blur-to-video recovers an entire sharp sequence from a single blurry image, inverting the temporal integration of the exposure. [ 15 ] first formulated this task with an ordering-invariant loss that accepts both forward and reversed sequences as valid targets, declaring the directional ambiguity unresolvable. Subsequent methods reduce the ambiguity via handcrafted motion priors [ 31 , 2 ] with limited out-of-distribution robustness. MotionETR [ 48 ] estimates per-pixel motion offsets and warps a predicted sharp image to produce the sequence. Animation-from-Blur [ 49 ] models motion ambiguity as multi-modal and conditions decomposition on a quantized motion-direction guidance (four discrete optical-flow directions), generating multiple plausible decompositions. HyperCUT [ 30 ] learns a hyperplane in latent space that separates forward from reversed sequences, using the vector side to assign temporal order. Most recently, Blur2Vid [ 37 ] fine-tunes a video diffusion transformer and treats directional ambiguity by sampling, producing plausible draws rather than a single committed reconstruction. Despite these advances, all methods predict sharp content directly, rather than modeling the integral structure that defines motion blur.
paragraphs.zh: 超越单帧去模糊，模糊转视频从单张模糊图像恢复出整段清晰序列，逆转曝光的时间积分过程。 [ 15 ] 首次提出了这一任务，采用一种顺序不变的损失函数，将正向和反向序列都视为有效目标，宣称方向歧义无法解决。 后续方法通过手工设计的运动先验 [ 31 , 2 ] 来降低歧义，但分布外鲁棒性有限。 MotionETR [ 48 ] 估计逐像素的运动偏移，并对预测的清晰图像进行变形以生成序列。 Animation-from-Blur [ 49 ] 将运动歧义建模为多模态，并基于量化的运动方向引导（四个离散光流方向）对分解进行条件化，生成多个合理的分解结果。 HyperCUT [ 30 ] 在隐空间中学习一个超平面，用以区分正向与反向序列，并利用向量的一侧来指定时间顺序。 最近，Blur2Vid [ 37 ] 微调了一个视频扩散 Transformer，并通过采样来处理方向歧义，生成多个合理的结果而非单一确定的重建。 尽管取得了这些进展，所有方法都直接预测清晰内容，而未对定义运动模糊的积分结构进行建模。

paragraphs.en: Flow Matching [ 21 , 23 , 1 ] is a generative modeling framework that learns to transform a simple prior distribution into a complex data distribution. This is achieved by training a network to predict the instantaneous velocity field along a continuous transport path between the two distributions. MeanFlow [ 10 ] instead trains a network on the average velocity over a time interval, which encodes the trajectory of the entire interval in a single prediction and lets one model handle arbitrary-interval queries. Subsequently, SplitMeanFlow [ 11 ] introduces an algebraic additivity identity as a training objective in the same average-velocity framework. We adopt this perspective in our work by training the network to predict the temporal average of sharp frames over a sub-interval of the exposure, rather than committing to a single sharp frame.

paragraphs.en: We train on the GoPro dataset [ 28 ] . Each blurry image is synthesized by averaging 7–13 consecutive sharp frames with a known temporal order over the exposure window, and we use all of these subframes as supervision targets during training. We train only on the GoPro training split and apply the same model to all evaluation datasets without any per-dataset fine-tuning. We conduct experiments on GoPro [ 28 ] , HIDE [ 35 ] , RealBlur-J, and RealBlur-R [ 32 ] for single-frame evaluation. For blur-to-video evaluation, we use GoPro-7, the 7-frame variant of the GoPro test split established by Jin et al. [ 15 ] and adopted by subsequent work [ 37 ] , where each blurred image is paired with seven sharp frames spanning the exposure.

paragraphs.en: We introduced PickMoment, a continuous-time reformulation of motion deblurring that predicts the interval-mean blur over arbitrary sub-intervals of the exposure. A single deterministic model unifies single-image deblurring, blur-to-video, and pick-a-moment recovery as different queries, trained with three supervisions derived from the integral definition: an empirical reconstruction loss, an additivity loss for self-consistency across sub-intervals, and a sharp-frame loss at the zero-interval limit. PickMoment achieves state-of-the-art single-image deblurring among generative-based methods on GoPro and HIDE, competitive performance on RealBlur, and the highest per-frame fidelity on GoPro-7 blur-to-video, all in a single forward pass. The main remaining gap is temporal smoothness, where iterative video-diffusion sampling still provides stronger implicit regularization; combining our deterministic interval-mean prediction with iterative sampling is a natural next step. We discuss further limitations in Appendix G .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 PickMoment，一种运动去模糊的连续时间重构方法，可在曝光的任意子区间上预测区间均值模糊。 单个确定性模型将单图像去模糊、模糊到视频和选定时刻恢复统一为不同的查询，并使用由积分定义导出的三种监督进行训练：经验重建损失、用于跨子区间自洽性的可加性损失，以及零区间极限下的清晰帧损失。 在单次前向传播下，PickMoment 在 GoPro 和 HIDE 上于基于生成式的方法中取得最先进的单图像去模糊效果，在 RealBlur 上表现具有竞争力，并在 GoPro-7 模糊到视频任务上实现最高的逐帧保真度。 主要的遗留差距在于时间平滑性，迭代式视频扩散采样仍能提供更强的隐式正则化；将我们的确定性区间均值预测与迭代采样相结合是自然的下一步。 我们在附录 G 中讨论更多局限性。

paragraphs.en: We instantiate f θ f_{\theta} on FLUX.2-klein-4B [ 3 ] , a ∼ \sim 4B-parameter diffusion transformer paired with a pretrained VAE ( ℰ , 𝒟 ) (\mathcal{E},\mathcal{D}) . paragraphs.en: We use the GoPro test split’s high-frame-rate subframes ( 11 11 sequences, ∼ \sim 1,100 frames each). For each sequence we sample 30 30 random 11 11 -frame windows, with a shared × 512 512\!\times\!512 random crop per window. For each window we sample 10 10 random triples ( s , t , m ) (s,t,m) with 0 ≤ s < m < t ≤ 1 0\leq s<m<t\leq 1 , | t − s | ≥ 0.2 |t-s|\geq 0.2 , and | m − s | , | t − m | ≥ 0.05 |m-s|,|t-m|\geq 0.05 , yielding 2,983 2{,}983 triples in total. We deliberately exclude very small intervals from this protocol because the additivity identity governs the regime where multiple subframes are averaged into each side of Eq. 8 ; the zero-interval limit s ≈ t s\approx t is supervised separately by ℒ sharp \mathcal{L}_{\text{sharp}} (and by the s = t s=t branch of ℒ recon \mathcal{L}_{\text{recon}} ) directly against the ground-truth sharp frame, so it is not governed by the additivity assumption being validated here. For each triple we compute B s , t B_{s,t} , B s , m B_{s,m} , B m , t B_{m,t} as the average of the subframes whose normalized timestamp falls in the corresponding interval, encode each through the frozen VAE to obtain z s , t z_{s,t} , z s , m z_{s,m} , z m , t z_{m,t} , and then form the additive prediction z pred = ω ​ z s , m + ( 1 − ω ) ​ z m , t z_{\text{pred}}=\omega z_{s,m}+(1-\omega)\,z_{m,t} . We decode both z s , t z_{s,t} and z pred z_{\text{pred}} back to pixel space and report PSNR against the corresponding pixel-space references.

paragraphs.en: Figs. 8 and 9 visualize the complementary roles of ℒ add \mathcal{L}_{\text{add}} and ℒ sharp \mathcal{L}_{\text{sharp}} in our full objective (cf. Table. 5 ), from two perspectives. paragraphs.en: We discuss three principal limitations of PickMoment. (i) Single-source supervision. The model is trained exclusively on GoPro_Large_All without auxiliary or domain-augmented data. While it generalizes to HIDE and RealBlur, on RealBlur-J it is competitive but does not consistently outperform FideDiff [ 22 ] , suggesting headroom from broader training distributions. (ii) Temporal smoothness vs. per-frame fidelity trade-off. PickMoment predicts each interval independently in a single forward pass. While this maximizes per-frame quality (PSNR p , LPIPS p in Table 3 ), the video-diffusion-based Blur2Vid retains a small advantage on cross-frame smoothness metrics (FVD, EPE), reflecting the implicit temporal regularization of its iterative sampling. (iii) Blur formation assumption. Eq. 1 assumes the blur is well modeled as a uniform temporal integral of sharp frames over a known exposure window, which fits the GoPro synthesis protocol but does not directly cover non-uniform exposures, severe rotational or radial blur, or camera-pipeline effects (e.g., rolling shutter, gamma). Generalization to such regimes is left for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们讨论 PickMoment 的三个主要局限。 (i) 单一来源监督。 模型仅在 GoPro_Large_All 上训练，没有使用辅助数据或域增强数据。 虽然它能泛化到 HIDE 和 RealBlur，但在 RealBlur-J 上表现有竞争力，却未能持续超越 FideDiff [ 22 ]，这表明通过更广泛的训练分布仍有提升空间。 (ii) 时间平滑性与单帧保真度之间的权衡。 PickMoment 在单次前向传播中独立预测每个区间。 虽然这最大化了单帧质量（表 3 中的 PSNR p 、LPIPS p ），但基于视频扩散的 Blur2Vid 在跨帧平滑性指标（FVD、EPE）上仍保持少量优势，这反映了其迭代采样所隐含的时间正则化。 (iii) 模糊形成假设。 式 1 假设模糊可以很好地建模为在已知曝光窗口内清晰帧的均匀时间积分，这符合 GoPro 的合成协议，但并不能直接涵盖非均匀曝光、严重的旋转或径向模糊，以及相机管线效应（如卷帘快门、伽马）。 对这些情形的泛化留待未来工作。
